author: Dyspa
body:
Hey all o/
As my last giveaway got a lot of participants I decided to make another 1 with credits being the theme this time.
Basically, this giveaway will work exactly the same as the other one. If you don't know what I'm talking about, all you gotta do is put your IGN and somewhere to contact you in the comment section.

With that said, good luck to all the people participating! 
Giveaway ends the 26th of May and same website will be used to choose the winner.
P.S: You can also tell me what do you want the next giveaway to be.. :´)
